issues.quote: suddenly see in the windows the deep sky
Suddenly I picture the green yard
it has already swallowed my room
how much of everything there is
And there iron chains are clanking
and their long shaggy coats leap on them
The red eyes leap, the broad forehead leaps, and the white fur breeches.
and only tosses the haystack of fur
drives your fiery rage back down it
while they take the chain off you

strengths.quote: It strikes a little hammer against a great crystal bell
and sows silence over the grass
Toothy fury strains and cannot quite burst out of the deep jaws
Ah, what a trifle that is! What a trifle, if only you knew…
strengths.why: hints at the narrator's hidden pain

strengths.quote: She rips at the grass with her claws, flings it behind her
And what about me? What? Forgotten me?
